title: 'If Traffic Is Sorted, Nothing Else To Dislike': Bengaluru Residents Share What Makes Their City Truly Special | Viral News - News18
text: Every city has its charm and its flaws, and for Bengaluru, pleasant weather is the one thing everyone talks about. But a recent online post has sparked a wholesome discussion by asking people to think beyond the climate. The post invited residents to share what they truly love about their city, something that makes living there special, apart from the famously cool weather. What followed was a wave of heartwarming and nostalgic responses from locals, each sharing their favourite part of life in Bengaluru. From its lush tree-lined roads to its lively cultural scene, the city’s spirit came alive through people’s words. A Post That Celebrated the City The post featured a striking picture of Kempegowda International Airport’s Terminal 2, often praised for its design and greenery. The man who shared it wrote, “For me, that is Kempegowda’s International Airport (Bengaluru Airport) Terminal 2. It is just awesome." His post sparked a lively exchange, with others quickly joining in to highlight what they love about their city. Within hours, the discussion drew several comments and upvotes. People Love Bengaluru for Its Spirit A user shared, “For me, Bengaluru has been the only city which gives me opportunities to pursue hobbies and fun stuff. Like if I want to go paintball, I can easily find places to go for, same for go-karting, pottery… I think very few cities come close to Bengaluru that give such opportunities." Another added, “Yeah my friend in Mumbai is bored to death when she sees my posts about book reading in Cubbon Park with a bunch of strangers. She’s like, man, I wish Mumbai had something like this." For some, it was the city’s greenery that stood out. “I like the trees, man. Especially in North Bengaluru, where I grew up. There are some roads where trees grow on both sides and completely cover the road like a canopy," one person wrote. Another said, “I like the people. No matter what your hobby is, you’ll find a group of people with the same interest." A Blend of Cultures and Tastes Several comments praised Bengaluru’s cosmopolitan mix. “I love it that most people I meet are well-travelled and can relate to international experiences and cuisine. On the same day, I can go enjoy some fine Mudde & upsaaru with local friends, one who drives a Porsche and another who rides a Splendor," a user wrote. “Filter kaapi. I’m yet to have a bad experience drinking coffee in Bengaluru," another said. One person simply summed up their love for the city’s nightlife and brewing culture: “Craft beer. It is unmatched in India. I want to start a brewery. One day. One day."
